- destination: one city (required)

HOW TO WORK
1. Ask for the missing required details in ONE short message (do not ask one question at a time).

3. Call save_trip_brief with all details, including origin_lat/origin_lon, destination_lat/destination_lon and
   destination_country from geocode_place. The first call only checks the details and answers
   "needs_confirmation": then show a short summary (destination with country, dates and number of days, origin,
   travellers, budget, interests) and ask the user to confirm. Stop and wait for their answer.
4. When the user confirms, call save_trip_brief again with the same details: now it saves them. If the user
   changes something, call it with the new details (that asks for confirmation again). If it returns an error,
   fix the fields it lists (ask the user if needed).
5. When save_trip_brief returns "ok", planning starts automatically (the planning team takes over and the user
   sees its progress). Do not call any other tool and do not write anything after that.

AFTER A GUIDE EXISTS
Answer questions about the trip ONLY from the guide below; if the guide does not say, say so. If the user wants
a different trip or changes (other dates, budget, destination), confirm the new details, save the new brief with
save_trip_brief and transfer to planning_pipeline again.
If a brief is saved but there is no guide (planning failed), say so plainly and ask whether to plan again. Planning
starts only through save_trip_brief returning "ok" (which needs the user's confirmation), never by itself.

## Day by day

### Day 1 – Mon 2027‑05‑10: Travel / Baixa
- **Weather**: clear, 14‑20 °C | Walk: – km
- **15:50 Arrive in Lisbon** – Flight with Finnair. [source](https://kiwi.com/u/p663wh)

### Day 2 – Tue 2027‑05‑11: Belém
- **Weather**: light rain, 13‑17 °C | Walk: 7.8 km
- **12:30 Mercado Oriental** – Low‑budget food court; try a pastel de nata. Hours 12:00–22:30. *Budget tier: low.* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa)
- **14:00 Mosteiro dos Jerónimos** – UNESCO monastery, iconic Manueline architecture; built early 1500s for Vasco da Gama’s voyage. ticket €18. Hours Oct‑May Tue‑Sun 10:00‑17:30; May‑Sep Tue‑Sun 10:00‑18:30. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)
- **15:00 Tram 15** – Tram connects Jerónimos, Monument to the Discoveries and Belém Tower. 
- **16:30 Monument to the Discoveries** – Celebrates the Age of Exploration; climb for panoramic river views. ticket €4. [source](http://www.padraodosdescobrimentos.pt/)
- **17:15 Belém Tower** – 16th‑century Manueline tower, symbol of Portugal’s maritime heritage. Ticket price: see the website. Hours Oct‑May Tue‑Sun 10:00‑17:30; May‑Sep Tue‑Sun 10:00‑18:30. [source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bel%C3%A9m_Tower)

### Day 3 – Wed 2027‑05‑12: Alfama
- **Weather**: drizzle, 13‑18 °C | Walk: 2.2 km
- **13:15 Néctar WineBar** – Mid‑budget lunch with Portuguese‑Mediterranean dishes. Hours 13:00‑24:00. *Budget tier: mid.* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa)
- **14:00 São Jorge Castle** – Hilltop fortress dating back to 1st century BCE; offers archaeological exhibits and city views. No ticket fee listed. Hours Mar‑Oct 10:00‑21:00; Nov‑Feb 09:00‑18:00. [source](https://www.castelodesaojorge.pt/en/)
- **16:00 Lisbon Cathedral** – Mother church of the city, built 1147; mixes Romanesque, Gothic and Baroque. No ticket. Hours Mon‑Sat 10:00‑18:30. [source](https://www.patriarcado-lisboa.pt/site/index.php?id=10686)
- **19:30 Rosa da Rua Restaurante** – Mid‑budget dinner; sample Portuguese, Indian and Cape Verdean flavours. Hours Mon‑Fri 12:00‑15:30 & 19:30‑22:30; Sat 19:30‑22:30. *Budget tier: mid.* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)

### Day 4 – Thu 2027‑05‑13: Baixa / Chiado
- **Weather**: drizzle, 13‑19 °C | Walk: 5.9 km
- **12:00 Faca & Garfo** – Mid‑budget lunch; grilled fish or meat, mains €6‑8. Hours 08:00‑24:00. *Budget tier: mid.* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)
- **13:30 National Museum of Ancient Art** – Houses European paintings, sculptures and decorative arts from Middle Ages to early 19th c. No ticket fee listed. Hours 10:00‑18:00 Tue‑Sun. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/98656587)
- **15:30 Museu Arpad Szenes – Vieira da Silva** – Modernist works of Hungarian painter Arpad Szenes and Portuguese artist Maria Helena Vieira da Silva. ticket €7.5. Hours 10:00‑18:00 Tue‑Sun. [source](https://fasvs.pt/)
- **19:30 Cervejaria da Trindade** – Mid‑budget dinner; codfish plates and craft beers. Hours Sun‑Thu 12:00‑24:00; Fri‑Sat 12:00‑01:00. *Budget tier: mid.* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)
- **20:30 Leitaria Camponeza** – Mid‑range dinner; ask for the espetadas. Hours 19:00‑23:00. *Budget tier: mid.* [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa)
